biography.value:
Description

This shambling corpse is twisted and mutilated. Fingers of sharpened bone reach out with malevolent intent. Though they may look like a zombie but beware they are your worst 'walking' dead enemy.

Defense

AC 21, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+5 dex, +6 natural)

hp 94 [126] (9d8+54)

Fort +8, Ref +6, Will +10

Defensive Abilities Channel Resistance +4; DR 5/slashing; Immune Undead Traits

Weakness Fire and Holy

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee Bite +13 (1d6+7 plus paralysis) and 2 claws +14 (1d8+7 plus paralysis)

Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

Special Attacks Drain Touch, Paralysis (1d4+1 rounds, DC 19), Sickening Breath

Statistics

Str 24, Dex 21, Con -, Int 17, Wis 18, Cha 20

Base Atk +6; CMB +13; CMD 28

Feats Cleave, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Step Up, Toughness, Weapon Focus (claw)

Skills Acrobatics +14, Climb +19, Perception +16, Stealth +17, Swim +15

Languages Common

ci: Fortitude-save effects unless they affect objects or are harmless

description.value: Defensive ability listed in the source statblock: Channel Resistance +4.
Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, the revenant can inflict more pain than normal. If they succeed at hitting with their bite attack, the damage is 1d6+7 x 1.5 for total damage.

effect: Bite on hit deals 1.5 times damage; apply bite paralysis as usual.

description.value: A revenant can absorb the blood from a target with a melee touch attack (+13). If it hits, the target take 4d6 points of shadow damage and the revenant is healed for that much. This spell also works against undead unlike most draining abilities. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 23).

effect: Heal the user for actual damage inflicted, including against undead.
Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 23).

Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 17).

tactics: During Combat The revenant starts combat with Sickening Breath or an ambush followed by Sickening Breath. When a revenant is below 50% health, they tend to use drain touch and when below 20% health they will flee. A revenant will even use drain touch on one of it's allies if need be.
